title: P7 checks whose labels claimed more than they asserted, a tax check that could not fail, and an unproven resume writer-death
what_went_wrong: A11 was labelled 'every restore across the suite hash-verified' while A15 deliberately produced an unverified restore that A11 did not count.
A10b was labelled 'exactly one tax row' but only flagged tax rows with a wrong amount; a duplicate correct-amount tax row passed.
p7_tax_rule_check.py printed DIFF/MISSING/STORED counts and always exited 0, yet was cited as a check.
The oracle wrote crash_safe=YES into every result file unconditionally.
The builder's DELETE ignored --cohort (WHERE 1=1 for --window ALL) while inserts were cohort-scoped; dormant because the live ledger holds only DR rows.
On resume the oracle waited on the bash wrapper's pid only, then removed the pid file and restored, even if the JVM writer was still alive; a corrupt hash file raised a traceback in stage_restore.

Found during P8 testing: the first cohort-scoped DELETE joined a utf8mb4 column to latin1 reg_periksa.no_rawat, which lost the index (a 31k-row DELETE ran ~30 min). Caught by the suite's runtime before any evidence was recorded; the run was stopped and its fixture torn down.
root_cause: Check labels were written from intent rather than from the assertion actually coded, and no negative test existed for cardinality, for the tax check's exit code, or for a SIGKILLed oracle leaving a live writer.
detection: Astra v7 (gpt-6-astra runs 4880158 and 4894730); each claim re-verified against source by the orchestrator on 2026-10-18 before fixing (P8 task doc §0 D1-D10). The join regression was detected by the P8 suite run 1 stalling in A10b.

correction.code: A11 relabelled and recomputed excluding A15/A18a/A18b, which are counted separately (must total 3); A10b adds a tax-row-count query and A10d plants a duplicate and a wrong tax row; p7_tax_rule_check exits 1 on any defect (+ duplicate detection, --db); crash_safe replaced by measured recovery counts; builder DELETE uses window AND cohort with the join converted into reg_periksa's charset (eq_ref, 0.07s); resume reap_writers kills recorded groups and any BilingHarness naming a run visit, then requires a quiet interval before restoring (WRITER-ALIVE otherwise); stage_restore treats an unreadable/foreign hash file as unverified; --retry-failed.
correction.verification: p8_recovery_unit_test.py 11/11; P8 suite on a fresh sik_p6f fixture (A10d, A10e, A17, A18a/b, A19, A20, A21 added); p8_builder_all_check.sh reproduces the live ledger content hash.

rule: A check's label may state only what its assertion tests; every cited check needs a planted-defect case proving it can fail; a resume must prove the previous writer dead, not wait on a wrapper pid.
